registre_de_la_chambre: Registre de la Chambre des Comtes de Rousset-Lavandieres, Vendomois, France
histoire_de_la_piece: Acquired in 1750 by the Comte de Saint-Georges, who inherited it from his father, le Duc de Montfort. Léonore de Roubaix acquired it in 1850 upon marrying Jacques de Brionne, her husband's uncle.
